# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

Be respectful, constructive, and welcoming. Assume good intent while discussing
ideas, and critique work rather than people. Harassment, discrimination,
personal attacks, threats, sexualized attention, deliberate intimidation, and
publishing another person's private information are not acceptable.

These expectations apply in repository issues, pull requests, discussions,
reviews, and other project spaces.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may edit or remove contributions and may temporarily or
permanently restrict participation when behavior is harmful to the community.
Enforcement decisions should consider context, severity, and whether behavior is
repeated.

Report conduct concerns privately to the maintainer through the contact options
on the [`nicksan222` GitHub profile](https://github.com/nicksan222). Do not open
a public issue containing sensitive personal information. Reports will be
reviewed as promptly and confidentially as practical.
